notes: *shall not be able* is two words, so rule 35's cannot-fusion does not apply: לֹא keeps *not* and יָכֹל keeps *shall be able*, headed on the complement by rule 44.
The two supplied *the*s in *the day of the wrath of Jehovah* fall on the two constructs, since no article morpheme stands anywhere in the chain (rule 29).
הָיָה is written in the לְנִדָּה clause and carries the copula, so the resultative לְ keeps only *as* rather than the whole frame of rule 49.
